EX-99.1 2 ea029591501ex99-1.htm TIZIANA LIFE SCIENCES LTD PRESS RELEASE, DATED JUNE 25, 2026 Exhibit 99.1 Tiziana Announces Last Patient Successfully Dosed in its Phase 2 INFORM-MS trial ● Top line data readout expected in late Q3/early Q4 ● INFORM-MS trial is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2a trial using Intranasal Foralumab in patients with Non-Active Secondary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis BOSTON, MA, June 25, 2026 – Tiziana Life Sciences, Ltd.

Topline data is expected in late Q3/early Q4 of 2026, and is planned to be presented at the 10th joint Americas Committee for Treatment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis (ACTRIMS) and ECTRIMS meeting in Toronto, Canada in October 2026.
The Company will continue monitoring patients through the 12-week treatment period and open-label extension, with topline data anticipated in the coming months.
